theorems.name: Submission.frt_td_ball_mass_upper_of_blowup
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ r₀ : ℝ), 0 < θ → 0 < r₀ → μ (closedBall x r₀) ≠ ⊤ → (∀ g : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, g (t⁻¹ • (z - x)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n]))) → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, ENNReal.ofReal θ * unitBallVolume n < c → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ (closedBall x t) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n
